newsitem.title: UK: Legal & General gains on broker "buy" view.
newsitem.headline: Legal & General gains on broker "buy" view.

text.p: Legal & General Plc shares gained 6p to 395p in a weaker overall market in heavy trade after Credit Lyonnais Laing reiterated its "buy" advice on the stock, dealers said.
The stock was fourth most heavily traded in the London market with approaching eight million shares traded.

"The dividend growth for the next three to four years will be about 14 percent and the stock is only a market yield compared with a dividend growth rate for Prudential at about 10 percent," said salesman Marcus Edwards-Jones.
Prudential Corp Plc fell 5p to 577p, with around 2.3 million shares traded.
